youtube.title: 6. The empty set is a subset of every set
youtube.body:
The book calls ∅ ⊆ S obvious. Subset is an if-then: if x is in empty, then x is in S. There is no such x, so the if never opens — vacuous truth.

Lean unfolds ⊆ and False, then names the corollary empty_subset. Turn-Lang writes the classroom sentence, unfolds Subset, and cites EmptySet.no_members from last clip.

Episode 6 of Abstract Algebra in a Proof Assistant.
